title: 完本感言
content_zh:
还有一个收获是，我终于领悟如何写大纲了，不是那种传统意义的剧情大纲，而是氛围大纲。
还有一个收获是，我终于领悟如何写大纲了，不是那种传统意义的剧情大纲，而是氛围大纲。
老读者都清楚，我这人写书是没有大纲的，绝大部分时候，我和每天跟读的读者一样，也不知道明天剧情会发生什么。
我觉得这很有趣，大家都收获了追读的快乐，完全没有剧透。
比如上架前，编辑那里让我交一份大纲，我说没有；最后没办法，只能随便写了一个交上去：大概意思是，爷爷被秩序神教的人杀死了，梅森叔叔为了保护主角，代替成为“邪神”也被杀死，然后卡伦在普洱的帮助下开始净化，走上了复仇之路。
记得那次起点给了个推荐，推荐标语是：《爷爷被杀死，主角走上向教会复仇之路》
比如尼奥，一开始他只是以一个“文员”的身份出场，我当时完全没想到会有尼奥这个角色，然后莫名其妙地，乐子人就出现了。
再者是对秩序之神的态度，一开始的想法，就是很老一套的“培育、夺舍”，然后卡伦和秩序之神必有一战；
但写着写着，感觉就发生了变化，这个变化就是卡伦对秩序之神的态度转变，从反对他到理解他再到成为他。
综上，我认为这种开放式写作，能带来很多乐趣和精彩。
至于卡文的问题，我状态好的时候，坐电脑前摸会儿鱼，想法就来了，也不觉得多难。
可等到创作线一拉长，我绷不住了；
另外就是，没有大纲无法避免地会导致一些大剧情之间的衔接处理和过度上，会显得生硬和唐突，有撕裂感。
好在，这方面我已经找到了解决和改善的思路，下本书时，我会做好氛围大纲，在保证创作开放度的同时，把控好氛围感和方向感。
至于下本书是哪个类别，目前还不清楚，想过下本再写本西幻，或者写本传统武侠，也想过下本写无限流，写玄幻架空或者悬疑……嘿，忽然发现我“英雄海”还挺深的。
我想，下本书的题材，还是得等自己准备开始下本创作时，按照当时的想法和冲动去决定了。
接下来，会是比较长的一段休息和充电时间。
首先，身体要好好调整好，创作八年，基本没修过什么假期，这才导致身体疲惫，同样的错误，不能再犯，没有一个健康状态的身体，书也写不出好的效果。
然后就是学习，不仅是针对性补强自己写作能力方面的短板，还得继续充电，写这本书时，涉及到稍微严肃论证的剧情时，往往会发现自己的思想薄弱和认知浅薄。
我想，等我休息好，和学习好后，下本书，应该会有更大的进步。

在这里衷心祝愿大家能身体健康，家庭和睦。
下本书时再聚！
content_en:
Another gain is that I finally understood how to write an outline, not a plot outline in the traditional sense, but an atmosphere outline.
Another gain is that I finally understood how to write an outline, not a plot outline in the traditional sense, but an atmosphere outline.
Regular readers know that I don’t have an outline when writing a book. Most of the time, like the readers I read with every day, I don’t know what will happen in the plot tomorrow.
I thought it was very interesting, and everyone had the pleasure of following it, without spoilers at all.
For example, before it was put on the shelf, the editor asked me to submit an outline, but I said no. In the end, I had no choice but to write and submit it casually: The general meaning is that grandpa was killed by the Cult of Kosmos, Uncle Mason was killed in order to protect the protagonist and became the "evil god" instead, and then Karen began to purify with the help of Pu'er and embarked on the road of revenge.
I remember that the starting point gave me a recommendation. The recommendation slogan was: "Grandpa is killed, the protagonist embarks on the road of revenge against the church."
For example, Neo, at the beginning, he only appeared as a "clerk". I didn't expect the character of Neo at all at the time, and then out of nowhere, the fun man appeared.
Furthermore, there is the attitude towards the God of Order. The initial thought was the same old-fashioned "cultivate and seize the body", and then Karen and the God of Order must have a battle;
But as I write, my feelings change. This change is Karen’s attitude towards the God of Order, from opposing him to understanding him and then becoming him.
To sum up, I think this kind of open-ended writing can bring a lot of fun and excitement.
As for the issue of Carvin, when I am in good condition, I sit in front of the computer and fish for a while, and ideas come to me, and I don’t find it difficult.
But once the creative line stretched, I couldn’t hold it any longer;
In addition, the lack of an outline will inevitably lead to excessive connections between some major plots, which will appear blunt and abrupt, with a sense of tearing.
Fortunately, I have found ways to solve and improve this aspect. When I write the next book, I will make an atmosphere outline to ensure the openness of creation while also controlling the sense of atmosphere and direction.
As for the category of the next book, it’s still unclear. I’ve thought about writing a western fantasy, or a traditional martial arts novel, or an infinite flow, fantasy, or suspense... Hey, I suddenly discovered that my “sea of ​​heroes” is quite deep.
I think that the subject of the next book will have to be decided according to my thoughts and impulses at the time when I am ready to start writing the next book.
Next, there will be a relatively long period of rest and recharging time.
First of all, the body must be well adjusted. After eight years of creation, I have rarely taken any vacations, which leads to physical exhaustion. The same mistakes cannot be made again. Without a healthy body, the book cannot be written well.
Then there is learning, which is not only to strengthen the shortcomings in one's writing ability, but also to continue to recharge. When writing this book, when it comes to a plot with a slightly serious argument, I often find that my thinking is weak and my cognition is shallow.
I think that after I have a good rest and study well, I should make greater progress in the next book.
Here I sincerely wish you all good health and family harmony.
See you next time for the next book!
